facts.value: The deferred-display subsystem maintains one ownership list plus separate texture-edge and translucent sort chains and counts. With Z-list collection disabled, those transparency classes render immediately; with collection enabled, records accumulate in the chains. Sorting is conditional on zsort_sorting, display always processes the texture-edge chain before the translucent chain, and completion clears every record and restores all list heads, tail pointers, and counts to their empty state. The forget-memory path performs the same structural reset without traversing potentially invalid allocations.
facts.rationale: The current collection guard, list construction, sorting guard, fixed replay order, cleanup traversal, and non-traversing forget-memory reset preserve the standing state-machine description.
